analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.doctor: Not needed right now — you can relax

reassuring.title: 🌿 Signs that are nothing to worry about
items: Swelling is expected for 3–7 days after laser treatment
Bruising darkens first, then fades naturally (a normal process)

lifestyle.title: 💊 Daily care that supports recovery
items: Cold compress: 3–4 times a day, 15 minutes each (first 48 hours)
Keep your face clean and avoid makeup for 3–5 days
Use SPF 50+ sunscreen whenever you go out
Avoid strenuous exercise for one week

redFlags.title: 🚨 Warning signs
items: Swelling that increases sharply after day 3

notice.title: ⚠️ Important notice
notice.body: This guidance is for aftercare reference only and is not a medical diagnosis. If any of the warning signs above appear, contact your clinic immediately.
